steps.title: Configure name resolution for all cluster nodes in /etc/hosts
steps.verification: Every cluster node's hostname resolves to its management IP address on this node.

steps.title: Install chrony on the controller and let the other nodes synchronize from it
steps.verification: chrony is installed and active on the controller, and chrony.conf allows the management subnet (plus the configured ntp_servers, if any).

steps.title: Configure time synchronization with chrony on the non-controller nodes
steps.verification: chrony is installed and active on this node, and chrony.conf uses only 'server controller iburst' as its pool/server source (actual synchronization is not checked yet).

steps.title: Enable the cloud-archive:epoxy repository and install python3-openstackclient
steps.verification: The cloud-archive:epoxy repository is enabled and python3-openstackclient is installed from it on this node.

steps.title: Install and configure MariaDB
steps.verification: mariadb-server and python3-pymysql are installed, 99-openstack.cnf sets the guide's [mysqld] keys (bind-address = the controller's management IP) and the mariadb service is active (SQL connectivity is not checked yet).

steps.title: Install and configure RabbitMQ
steps.verification: rabbitmq-server is installed and active, and the RabbitMQ 'openstack' user exists with '.* .* .*' permissions in vhost '/' (no AMQP connection or TCP port 5672 check is performed).

steps.title: Install and configure Memcached
steps.verification: memcached and python3-memcache are installed, /etc/memcached.conf listens only on the controller's management IP (-l) and the memcached service is active (no TCP connection is tested).

steps.title: Install and configure etcd
steps.verification: etcd-server is installed, /etc/default/etcd sets the page's nine ETCD_* keys for the controller's management IP, and the etcd service is enabled and active (no TCP connection or cluster health is tested).

steps.title: Install and configure the Keystone Identity service
steps.verification: keystone is installed, /etc/keystone/keystone.conf sets [database] connection and [token] provider = fernet, /etc/apache2/apache2.conf sets ServerName controller, /etc/openstack-forge/admin-openrc exists with mode 0600, Fernet and credential key repositories are initialized, the keystone MariaDB database and grants exist, apache2 is active, and the Keystone 'service' project exists in domain 'default'.

steps.title: Install and configure the Glance Image service
steps.verification: glance is installed, /etc/glance/glance-api.conf sets the [database], [keystone_authtoken], [paste_deploy], [DEFAULT], [glance_store], and [fs] keys, the glance MariaDB database and grants exist, the Keystone 'glance' user has the 'admin' role on 'service', the 'glance' ('image') service and its public/internal/admin endpoints (http://controller:9292) exist in RegionOne, and glance-api is active (no HTTP check on port 9292 or image upload test is performed).

steps.title: Install and configure the Placement service
steps.verification: placement-api is installed, /etc/placement/placement.conf sets the [placement_database], [api], and [keystone_authtoken] keys, the placement MariaDB database and grants exist, the Keystone 'placement' user has the 'admin' role on 'service', the 'placement' ('placement') service and its public/internal/admin endpoints (http://controller:8778) exist in RegionOne, and apache2 is active (no HTTP check on port 8778 or placement-status upgrade check is performed).

notes.title: Host network configuration is an open decision
notes.text: The official installation guide configures network interfaces on Ubuntu by editing /etc/network/interfaces, but Ubuntu 24.04 configures networking with netplan. How OpenStack Forge will handle network configuration has not been decided, so the catalog contains no network configuration step.
